about: Yearly loading plan built from data/season_calendar.json (twin/season_plan.py). All E.
note: Digital twin (S) on real 2026 Visakhapatnam weather. Nothing here is measured. E = assumption (config/design.json -> assumptions_E, data/crops.json, data/season_calendar.json).

research_estimate.note: E – crop-calendar research estimate for a full year.

high_value_definition: days with stock that belongs to a festival hold or to post-festival surplus (glut saving)

muhurtham_proxy.note: E – exact muhurtham days were not available; in wedding seasons Fridays and Sundays stand in for muhurtham / puja days, Tuesdays and Wednesdays for slack days.

price_model.note: E – price = base price of the month (data/crops.json) x supply factor x day factor. 2 days up to and on a festival x2.5 (brief: x2-3); 4 days after x0.4 (brief: x0.3-0.5 for 3-5 days); muhurtham-proxy days x1.4, slack days x0.8. Anchors (Vizag press, E): marigold Rs 50 -> 150-200/kg before Deepavali 2025, jasmine Rs 250-300/kg; Sravana: marigold 160 -> 200, rose 280 -> 500, chamanthi 380 -> 600; marigold crash to about Rs 50 a basket after Deepavali.
price_model.surplus_note: E – everyday surplus: flowers not sold by the end of the day are held whenever the expected freshness after the hold is at least 80 % and the expected price on the sale day is not below today's price. Without the room this surplus would fetch only half of today's price (distress sale), so value = kg sold x sale price x freshness - kg x 0.5 x today's price.

research_estimate.note: E – crop-calendar research estimate for a full year.

months.1: Marigold, chamanthi and rose: hold before Sankranti, then weekly cycles for weddings.
months.2: Rose for Valentine's Day and weddings (bagged, up to 3 days).
months.3: Jasmine season starts: load on slack days, sell on muhurtham days and Fridays.
months.5: Jasmine glut, busiest wedding month: hold 1–3 days.
months.7: Jasmine and tuberose; Ashadha has no weddings – store only for Fridays.
months.8: Build stock 3–5 days before Sravana Fridays and Varalakshmi Vratam.
months.9: Marigold and chamanthi: hold 2–5 days before Vinayaka Chavithi; store the surplus after.
months.10: Marigold and chamanthi: hold before Bathukamma and Dasara.
months.11: Hold before Deepavali; then weekly cycles before Karthika Mondays and Fridays.
months.12: Chamanthi, marigold, rose: Karthika Mondays, weddings, Christmas; hold before Sankranti.
